newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds says Brazil bank "plans' speculation.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds says Brazil bank "plans' speculation.

text.p: Lloyds TSB Group Plc on Wednesday described as "complete speculation" a statement by one of its Brazilian associates that Lloyds Bank has a strategy to expand operations in Brazilian retail banking.

Lloyds issued a statement in London confirming that it is in discussions with Banco Multiplic, of which it owns 50 percent, with a view to buying the consumer finance business of Multiplic as well as some other unspecified assets.
Brazilian press reports have put the cost of the deal at $600 million but analysts said this looked a bit on the high side.
They also doubted that Lloyds would have any major plans to expand in Brazil at this stage as this would not fit in with its core UK-based retail banking and financial services business.

On Tuesday, Ronaldo Cesar Coelho, a 50 percent shareholder in Multiplic Empreendimentos which owns half of Banco Multiplic, said the acquisition of Multiplic's assets is part of a strategy to expand Lloyds' interests in Brazil.
He said the deal should be concluded in the next six months.
